breaks: The --backend cpu and --backend hybrid options are no longer supported; pass --backend npu instead.
All CPU and hybrid model IDs (e.g., Llama-3.2-1B-Instruct-CPU) were removed; use the new NPU model IDs (e.g., Llama-3.2-1B-Instruct-NPU).
Checkpoint paths changed from onnx-ryzenai format to *_rai_1.9.0_npu format.
break_rulings.why: Upgrading from v2026.48, any setup that references --backend cpu or --backend hybrid or uses old CPU/hybrid model IDs will fail to start.
The container descriptor API gained a new user field and replaced group_id() with device_group_ids(), but the gufo:rocm backend contract is unchanged for users.

breaks: POST /v1/responses with a collection.router and previous_response_id, conversation, or item_reference now returns 400 instead of routing to a candidate.
The previous_response_id argument is now marked as Support::Partial because llama.cpp rejects it and router collections also reject it.
break_rulings.why: Upgrading to this release, workflows that continue earlier responses through a router collection will fail with a 400 error.
Only a version string update in backend_versions.json; no API, CLI, or config change.
The four cost metadata keys are optional additions to existing routes; existing clients are unaffected.

breaks: On Windows, gufo:rocm switches from a containerized backend bound to 0.0.0.0 to a native backend bound to 127.0.0.1, removing external network access.
break_rulings.why: Windows users upgrading from v2026.48 where gufo:rocm ran as a container on 0.0.0.0 will find the new native installation binds to localhost only.
The former_images field is additive; container upgrade/uninstall logic is internal.
CI-only workflow changes; no user-facing surface.
The auto value for default_model_source is additive; the default remains huggingface.

breaks: Models registered, pulled, loaded, or having options patched or deleted through the REST API with backend argument keys (llamacpp_args, whispercpp_args, merge_args) now require the admin API key; the regular API key returns 403.
The ModelManager C++ API changes: download_model(), register_model(), register_user_model(), and replace_options() now require an allow_backend_args parameter.
break_rulings.why: Upgrading to this release with an admin key configured, any request containing backend argument keys will receive 403 unless authenticated with the admin key.

breaks: For OpenMOSS models, a non-empty voice field now triggers voice design (Generate reference sample) instead of being used as a style instruction; existing clients sending voice=default will see unexpected voice design behavior.
break_rulings.why: Upgrading to this release, OpenMOSS models change the semantics of the voice field, breaking existing setups that use it for style instructions.
CI runner inventory JSON only; no user-facing surface.

breaks: stable-diffusion.cpp backend now explicitly rejects output_format=mp4; use the TheNoise backend for MP4 output.
break_rulings.why: Upgrading, requests to stable-diffusion.cpp with output_format=mp4 will now be rejected instead of being silently passed through.

breaks: Loom model bundles cached before this release that lack a Quick start record in info.json will fail to load, even if they worked before.
The kDefaultDevice constant and BundlePlan::preset field were removed from the Loom public API.
break_rulings.why: Upgrading Loom users with older cached bundles on offline or restricted networks will find their models refuse to load.
Version pin updates in backend_versions.json and a generated header; no API or behavior change.
Token stripping fix hardens existing behavior; setups with clean tokens are unaffected.

All CPU and hybrid model IDs (e.g., Llama-3.2-1B-Instruct-CPU) were removed; use the new NPU model IDs (e.g., Llama-3.2-1B-Instruct-NPU).
Checkpoint paths changed from onnx-ryzenai format to *_rai_1.9.0_npu format.

The previous_response_id argument is now marked as Support::Partial because llama.cpp rejects it and router collections also reject it.

evidence.blockers: The ryzenai NPU upgrade (b771b4f) needs real NPU hardware verification. The gufo:rocm migration (64dff4a, f8db59b) requires testing on Strix Halo with rootless Podman and Docker. The Loom quick_start requirement (be70f87) will break older cached bundles on offline systems. The backend args authorization boundary (a4f93a0) needs testing with all key configurations. The auto-tune context-size changes (82706b2) need verification on Strix Halo and discrete GPU systems.
evidence.breaking_changes: ryzenai drops all CPU and hybrid model support in favor of NPU-only; model IDs and checkpoint paths changed. /v1/responses now rejects previous_response_id, conversation, and item_reference on collection.router. On Windows, gufo:rocm switches from container (0.0.0.0) to native (127.0.0.1). Backend args authorization requires admin API key for any request with backend argument keys. OpenMOSS voice field semantics changed: non-empty voice triggers voice design instead of style instruction. Loom bundles without Quick start fail to load. stable-diffusion.cpp rejects output_format=mp4.
evidence.coverage: All 50 commits in the release range were reviewed. One commit (47bf509) had a post-approval merge from another PR that changed container-backend code without renewed review. The CI test-exe-devlab-backends job (3609f34) was not run on this PR due to workflow gating.
evidence.manual_testing: Real GPU hardware verification needed: (1) NPU inference with ryzenai, (2) gufo:rocm on Strix Halo with rootless Podman and Docker, (3) auto-tune context sizing on AMD UMA and discrete GPUs, (4) Loom inference on Strix Halo/R9700, (5) all six media job operations with real models, (6) video generation with sd-cpp and TheNoise, (7) web search through GUI and MCP, (8) ModelScope mirror install, (9) MCP model management tools through an MCP client, (10) the a4f93a0 security boundary with all key configurations.
evidence.security: PR #4211 closes an authorization gap where regular API callers could override backend command-line arguments. The fix adds an allow_backend_args gate to every mutating path. PR #4201 adds web search with bounded RSS parsing and follow_redirects=false. The oversized GGUF array guard prevents DoS. The ModelScope mirror sync uses sparse checkout and scoped tokens.
